title: Janus Engine — Howl's Moving Castle simulation RUN-002, geometry-grounded
purpose: Replace RUN-001's implicit large flow area with the actual 62.3 mm Axle-derived module scale and determine how much independently supplied ring-equivalent area is required before self-drive is mathematically possible.

screening_operating_point.assumption_warning: K, capture fraction, processing energy, core efficiency and fixed auxiliary load remain unmeasured placeholders. Only the 3MF bounding geometry is grounded in the supplied model.

single_module_result.interpretation: The actual 62.3 mm module radically reduces the oxygen supply relative to RUN-001. One module can only afford about 55 W of shared fixed load at this screening point before reaching zero shaft surplus.

aggregate_scaling.rule: Only independently supplied fresh-water area may be multiplied. Concentric rings exposed to the same depleted water parcel are not independent modules.

seventeen_module_equivalent.reason: 17 independently supplied 62.3 mm frontal-area equivalents approximately reproduce the 100 L/s / 0.4 g/s scale of RUN-001 at 2 m/s and 50% capture.

oxygen_target_scaling_at_2m_s.important_boundary: Ring-equivalent count is an area/throughput equivalence, not a prescription to physically nest that number of rings.

single_aperture_equivalence.interpretation: If the design uses one dominant frontal water-flow aperture instead of distributed modules, the first RUN-001 flow scale belongs to roughly a 25 cm class flow aperture, not a 6.23 cm one.

velocity_optimization_screen.model: DeltaP = 0.5*rho*v^2 with K=1; core and gas-processing powers scale with oxygen captured; fixed shared load omitted for per-module optimization.
velocity_optimization_screen.interpretation: The simple model has an optimum because oxygen supply rises approximately linearly with water velocity while hydraulic power rises approximately cubically. This optimum is not a measured Janus operating point.

run001_revision.old_interpretation: 100 L/s assigned to an abstract gill system
run001_revision.new_interpretation: RUN-001 is an aggregate-area system point. It must not be attributed to one 62.3 mm ring.

dominant_unknowns_now: real membrane active area inside one 62.3 mm module
real oxygen transfer coefficient and capture fraction versus RPM and water velocity
real torque required to rotate the gill geometry in water
fresh-water renewal between concentric / axial rings
real gas-conditioning energy per kg O2
selected fuel/core and actual shaft efficiency

verdict.most_important_design_change: Treat the coin-scale Axle as a module/core geometry and design the gill system as a much larger effective exchange surface around it rather than expecting the coin-scale frontal area alone to feed the full engine.

next_gate: R0A1_MEMBRANE_AREA_AND_FRESH_WATER_RENEWAL: choose a realizable lamella / porous / hollow-channel gill architecture inside or around the 62.3 mm Axle scale, calculate actual active membrane area and flow lanes, then replace capture_fraction with a transport model or measurement.
